---
title: Auto-stretch keeps the figure caption location
format: revealjs
fig-cap-location: top
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'section#top > p.caption + img.r-stretch#fig-top'
          - 'section#unlabelled > p.caption + img.r-stretch'
          - 'section#knitr > div.cell + p.caption + img.r-stretch#fig-knitr'
          - 'section#bottom > img.r-stretch#fig-bottom + p.caption'
        -
          - 'section#top > img.r-stretch + p.caption'
          - 'section#unlabelled > img.r-stretch + p.caption'
          - 'section#knitr > img.r-stretch + p.caption'
          - 'section#bottom > p.caption + img.r-stretch'
---

## Top {#top}

A figure alone on a slide is auto-stretched: the image moves out of its figure to the slide level and its caption is rebuilt as a `p.caption` next to it. That caption must stay above the image when `fig-cap-location: top` is set.

![Caption on top](https://placehold.co/100x50.png){#fig-top}

## Unlabelled {#unlabelled}

![Caption on top](https://placehold.co/100x50.png)

## Knitr {#knitr}

```{r}
#| label: fig-knitr
#| fig-cap: "Caption on top"
#| echo: true
plot(1:10)
```
